units: dimensionless, R = c_f = 1, g = K/(R c_f^2); lambda in c_f/R; omega_hat = Im lambda; f = g*omega_hat/(2 pi) at K = 1 (R = 1/g)

controls.name: (1) g = 0: Delta(lambda) = lambda^2 I exactly (lambda = 0 with multiplicity 12 per degree of freedom, 24 for det); every scalar block reduces to lambda^2

(2) known (hand-derived): the three rigid rotations of the hexagon are null vectors of Delta(0) at g = 4, 1, 1/10, and the scalar blocks (k=0,t), (k=+-1,z) vanish at lambda = 0; this tests the projection-variation term -a0 and the kernel assembly
(3) negative: without the projection-variation term the rotation null vectors fail (residual must be order a0 = 0.67)
(4) structure: blocks are circulant in the rotating tangent frames, t and z decouple, and det(full 12x12) equals the product of the 12 scalar blocks at a test point
